title: Book Three · Chapter 24: The Photo Comes Home
story:
On Thursday of the next week, the teacher brings the class photos.

She puts a thick envelope on her desk. Soon everyone has a picture in front of them.

Ronan finds Kai first. His mouth is open just a little. The boy beside him looks very serious.

“He said the funny thing,” Ronan tells Kai. “You got the face.”

Kai leans closer. “You are smiling too.”

“At the wind.”

Anna turns her own photo round. She is near the front with her friends. One girl's collar is still crooked.

“We tried,” she says.

“It waited until the camera was ready,” Ronan answers.

All around the room, students point to faces. Someone complains about closed eyes. Someone else wants to see the back row.

The teacher lets them look for a minute. Then she asks them to put the pictures away.

Ronan slides his into a book. He keeps the whole picture inside the cover. No corner sticks out.

At home, Mum has a customer near the window. Ronan leaves the book in his bag until the woman goes.

Then he takes out the photo and lays it on the table.

Mum pulls her chair closer.

“There you are.”

“At the back.”

“I can see you. Who is beside you?”

“Kai. He fixed the pencil sharpener.”

Ronan points to the right face. He shows her Anna near the front too.

“She likes the maths book,” he says. “And running.”

“You told me.”

Mum looks at the whole class. Then she puts a clean sheet under the photo. There is a little thread on the table, and she brushes it away.

Dad comes home later with a cold nose. He washes his hands before he touches the picture.

“A big class,” he says.

“They don't all look so quiet every day.”

“You aren't always quiet either.”

Dad holds the picture closer to the light. Ronan shows him Kai and Anna again. He knows a few more names now, and he says those too.

“Do you eat lunch with all of them?” Dad asks.

“Not all. Sometimes Anna goes to meet her friend. I play with the boys.”

He points to the serious boy beside Kai.

“He throws the ball to me.”

Dad looks from that face to Ronan's.

“You both look ready for a lesson here.”

“The teacher was watching.”

Mum smiles. She leans closer to see the serious face for herself.

“Where is the ball?” Dad asks.

Ronan laughs. “Kai's friend asked that.”

“A good question.”

After dinner, Ronan looks for a place to keep the photo. He does not want it loose in his school bag.

He puts it inside the cover of his birthday book. Leo's address paper is still there, on the other side.

For a moment, he looks at both. He wants Leo to see the new faces. He only has one copy of the photo, so he leaves it in the book.

Then he writes Kai's name on a small piece of paper. Below it, he writes Anna and the names he knows from the picture.

He puts that paper beside the photo. Tomorrow he can ask about the faces he still cannot name.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

thick＝厚的；crooked＝歪的；stick out＝伸出来；copy＝一份、一张。

## 理解问题

1. 合影什么时候拿到？Ronan怎样保护它，没有马上带给父母看是为什么？
2. 他最后把照片放在哪里？为什么没有立即寄给Leo？

## 读句子

**No corner sticks out.**

拆开看：No corner / sticks out.

没有任何一个角／露在外面。
